# 396. Rotate Function

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(n))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def maxRotateFunction(self, nums):
        """
        :type nums: List[int]
        :rtype: int
        """
        n = len(nums)
        cur_num = 0
        for i in range(n):
            cur_num += i * nums[i]
        ans = cur_num
        nums_sum = sum(nums)
        for i in range(1, n):
            cur_num = cur_num + nums_sum - n * nums[n - i]
            ans = max(ans, cur_num)
        return ans
```
